Brain & Mind Academy · Abhyas Practice Series · Advanced Practice DSAT Paper 10 (top-level series)
Built to the College Board Digital SAT format: Reading and Writing 2 × 27 questions (32 min each), 10-minute break, Math 2 × 22 questions (35 min each), with the standard domain mix. Only the hardest questions are used. Reading and Writing: the hardest third of College Board SAT Practice Tests 4–11 and the Hard+ and Hard++ questions of the Abhyas “++” series (Brain & Mind originals and College Board items). Math: Hard questions of the College Board SAT Suite Question Bank, shown as published, with the Hard+ and Hard++ questions of the “++” series; every Math question appears in only one paper of this series, and Reading and Writing questions recur across papers but never within a paper. Topic tags and the Score Gap Report are by Brain & Mind Academy. SAT is a trademark of the College Board, which is not affiliated with Brain & Mind Academy.
